answer.reason: The verses give two things Jabin did: he summoned the northern kings against Israel, and he oppressed Israel for twenty years after the LORD sold them into his hand.

clauses.english: sent to the neighbouring kings to gather them against Israel
clauses.quote: Jabin king of Hazor had heard those things, that he sent to Jobab king of Madon

clauses.english: mightily oppressed Israel for twenty years, when the LORD sold them into his hand
clauses.quote: the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin king of Canaan

doubts: JOS 10:33 and JOS 12:12 are marked but concern Horam king of Gezer and the king of Eglon, not Jabin, so they were left out.
JOS 11:1-3 does not state why the kings were summoned, only that Jabin sent to them; 'against Israel' is implied by 'those things'.
JDG 4 calls Jabin king of Canaan, who may be a different king of Hazor from the one in Joshua.
